source.title: WRC Investigation - Vietnamese Competitions Results Removal
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) has recently concluded an investigation into WCA competitions in Vietnam, resulting in the removal of many results from competitions between the years of 2013 and 2022. 

The WRC has found that at many of these competitions, score sheets were used as cube covers, which violates regulation [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1) and guideline [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+). These small pieces of paper do not do a sufficient job covering the cube, allowing scrambled puzzles to be seen before competitors' attempts. Scramble secrecy is something that is treated very seriously and violations of it cannot be ignored. 

Additionally, there is a small number of competitions that used Yuxin timers, which were not approved timers as per [8a7](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/history/official/2016-04-18/#8a7). Under current regulations, this is regulation [7f1a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#7f1a). Due to inconsistencies with these timers, the results from competitions that used them must be removed.

This is not the first time that results have been removed for these issues. Results have been removed for scoresheets being used as covers [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/31) as well as at [Hanoi Open 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/70). Results have been removed for using Yuxin timers at [Vancouver Island 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/80). While these issues are not the fault of the competitor, they were not achieved in accordance with the WCA Regulations and must be removed. 

As a result of this investigation, results from 19 competitions in Vietnam were affected, including 9 competitions that no longer have any results. Over 900 competitors were affected, with more than 18,000 attempts removed in total, and many competitors had their WCA ID reassigned or lost due to their missing results. We completely empathize with the frustration that this causes, but our regulations are carefully written such that competitors can’t obtain any unfair advantages. If these aren’t followed, then we cannot guarantee the integrity of our results.

Of course, this decision impacts a significant number of solves that might be otherwise valid. However, given the number of clear violations in the rest of these rounds, we can not confidently accept these results.

We want to take this opportunity to remind everyone the importance of understanding the Regulations. If you have any questions about the Regulations, please contact either your WCA Delegate or the WCA Regulations Committee at [regulations@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:regulations@worldcubeassociation.org).

A full report for this investigation can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E-J8WRfld6mpbHslM3rW10fNSsXgkl2y/view?usp=sharing), and the incident log entry can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/79).

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会调查：移除越南部分比赛成绩
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）近期完成了对越南 WCA 比赛的调查，并因此移除了 2013 至 2022 年间多场比赛的大量成绩。

WRC 发现，许多比赛使用成绩单充当魔方罩，违反了规则 [A2c1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A2c1) 和指南 [A2c1+](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/guidelines.html#A2c1+)。这些小纸片无法充分遮住魔方，导致选手在还原开始前就能看到打乱后的状态。打乱保密是必须严肃对待的问题，违反保密要求的情况不能忽视。

此外，少数比赛使用了裕鑫计时器，而这类计时器不在规则 [8a7](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/history/official/2016-04-18/#8a7) 认可的计时器之列。现行规则中的对应条款为 [7f1a](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#7f1a)。由于这些计时器存在不一致的问题，使用它们的比赛成绩必须移除。

这并非首次因这些问题移除成绩。[这起事件](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/31)以及 [Hanoi Open 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/70) 都曾因使用成绩单作魔方罩而被移除成绩；[Vancouver Island 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/80) 也曾因使用裕鑫计时器而被移除成绩。尽管这些问题不是选手的过错，相关成绩并非在符合 WCA 竞赛规则的条件下取得，因此必须移除。

本次调查影响了越南 19 场比赛的成绩，其中 9 场比赛已无任何有效成绩。超过 900 名选手受到影响，共移除了超过 18,000 次还原成绩；许多选手也因成绩缺失而被重新分配 WCA ID，或失去了 WCA ID。我们完全理解这会让大家感到失望，但规则经过仔细制定，就是为了防止选手获得任何不公平优势。如果不遵守规则，我们便无法保证成绩的公正可信。

这项决定当然也影响了大量原本可能有效的还原。但鉴于这些轮次中的其他还原存在诸多明确违规，我们无法有把握地认可这些成绩。

借此机会，我们再次提醒大家：理解竞赛规则十分重要。如有规则方面的疑问，请联系所在地区的 WCA 代表，或通过 [regulations@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:regulations@worldcubeassociation.org) 联系 WCA 规则委员会。

本次调查的完整报告见[此处](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1E-J8WRfld6mpbHslM3rW10fNSsXgkl2y/view?usp=sharing)，事件日志条目见[此处](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/79)。
